capabilities: Generate AI explanation notes for selected Japanese text and save them as notes
Break down Japanese sentences word by word with grammar points and rewrites
Look up words in offline Jitendex and JMnedict dictionaries with pitch accents
Read selected text aloud via Google or Windows TTS engines
Convert epub files to per-chapter Markdown files with extracted images
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. After install, the Lexis plugin's settings must also be pointed at the plugin's output directories; dictionaries (Jitendex, JMnedict) are downloaded from within the settings page.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI explanations, grammar breakdowns, or dictionary lookups for Japanese text selected while reading or writing.

relations.evidence: 需要先安装并启用 Lexis 插件

summary: Japanese study helper that sends selected text to an LLM for explanation and grammar notes, plus offline dictionary lookup, TTS, and epub conversion.
